findings.text: reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:3398 blocking: the changed resume branch adds an extra pane row on a pipe re-arm, which reddens two existing cases in tests/test_follower_rearm_shows_nothing_twice.py (lines 425 and 462, both asserting len(rows)==1). At 42b22212d5 the file reports 2 failed, 7 passed; at bc6d7fd9 the same file reports 9 passed; and with only reckon/crew_follow_commands.py reverted in a scratch copy of the head tree the same tests report 9 passed, so the regression is caused by this change and not by the test revision. The node's done-when requires that the test files importing the changed module add no failure against the base revision, and this file is one of them.
